# Overview

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "calibration",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Implementation = "calibration-implementation.html",
    Theory = "calibration-theory.html"
  )
)
```

```{r calibration_overview, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_overview(
  family = "calibration",
  summary = paste(
    "The solid elastic sphere modal-series model (`SOEMS`) calculates the",
    "reference response of homogeneous metal calibration spheres. In package",
    "calls, select it with `model = \"calibration\"` or the `soems` alias."
  ),
  core_idea = paste(
    "Expand the exterior acoustic field and the solid's longitudinal and shear",
    "displacements in spherical modes, enforce the fluid-solid interface",
    "conditions, and sum the elastic phase shifts [@Hickling_1962;",
    "@Maclennan_1981]."
  ),
  best_for = c(
    "Standard-target calibration spheres made from homogeneous elastic solids",
    paste(
      "Frequency-dependent reference spectra for specified sphere materials",
      "and diameters"
    ),
    "Comparison with published calibration-sphere calculations"
  ),
  supports = c(
    "`CAL` objects created with `cal_generate()`",
    paste(
      "Built-in calibration materials or user-supplied density and",
      "longitudinal and shear speeds"
    ),
    "Adaptive or fixed modal truncation"
  ),
  assumptions = c(
    "A perfectly spherical, homogeneous isotropic solid",
    "Linear elasticity within the sphere and an inviscid exterior fluid",
    "No coating, shell, cavity, or material gradient",
    "Material and water properties match the actual calibration conditions"
  ),
  reading = c(
    paste(
      "[Implementation](calibration-implementation.html): building",
      "standards, spectra, and external comparisons"
    ),
    paste(
      "[Theory](calibration-theory.html): elastic potentials, interface",
      "conditions, and phase shifts"
    )
  )
)
```

## Calibration workflow

```{r calibration_workflow_map, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
workflow_svg <- readLines(
  "../calibration-workflow/calibration-workflow-map.svg",
  warn = FALSE
)
workflow_svg <- workflow_svg[!grepl("^<\\?xml", workflow_svg)]
knitr::asis_output(paste(workflow_svg, collapse = "\n"))
```

A calibration calculation is only a reference when diameter, material
properties, surrounding water, and frequency match the physical standard
[@Dragonette_1981; @Foote_1990]. The [material-properties
guide](../material-properties/material-properties.html) covers non-default
inputs.
